bookmarks.title: History of Market — The Chronicle of the U.S. Stock Market
bookmarks.excerpt: A continuously maintained, century-scale chronicle of the U.S. stock market across six tabs (S&P 500, Nasdaq, Semiconductors, Information Technology, Financials, Magnificent 7). Each chapter answers one question — the shape of returns, the rhythm of crisis, the anchors of valuation, the anatomy of the index, the sector-specific structure — using the S&P 500 (since 1928), Nasdaq Composite (since 1971), Nasdaq 100 / QQQ (since 1985), Dow Jones (since 1914), Philadelphia Semiconductor Index (since 1994), XLK (since 1998), XLF (since 1998), and an equal-weighted Magnificent 7 composite. Includes Shiller CAPE, trailing / forward PE, year-by-year valuation vs EPS driver decomposition, the MU/NVDA vs 1999 dotcom-peak valuation overlay, and 2008-cohort financial-crisis anatomy.
